result.summary:
INT-offline-lease adversary vs integration HEAD 30a4065036a917514fb4984fde73f87867f38619. 18 attack tests pushed on devin/pp/adv/offline-lease-30a40650 @ 24ae27d0cc4d6ebe5f6c28815424de1a679aded9 (three new test files only; no production code, migrations or existing tests modified; no PR opened). 4 CONFIRMED breaks (2×P1, 1×P2, 1×P3), 14 attacks held.

RUNS (all VERIFIED, Linux, disposable Postgres only):
[A] Postgres allocation/reclaim suite — `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && XC_PG_URL=postgres://postgres:pg@127.0.0.1:55433/postgres npx --yes deno@2.5.6 test -A --no-check --config deno.json xc_pg_offline_lease_adversary.test.ts` → exit 1; 8 executed / 6 passed / 2 failed / 0 skipped (pg_run4.clean.log; identical verdicts in earlier runs 1,2). FAILED = breaks OL-PG-1, OL-PG-4. HELD: OL-PG-2 conservation under reclaim — with three outstanding permits (one stale) no sync order ever records a 3rd free scored row, refused permits end released/free_limit_exceeded; OL-PG-3 the hourly sweep relabels a stale reservation released/expired (never deletes) and the swept permit still backs its late sync while an allowance slot remains; OL-PG-5 account switch — a second account cannot consume, replay or free-ride on the victim's permit id or shot id (access.permit_not_found / owner isolation), victim allocation untouched; OL-PG-6 same idempotency key after the sweep returns the swept permit, never a fresh reservation or second slot; OL-PG-7 the same late shot synced twice concurrently against a swept permit yields one row and one consumed permit; OL-PG-8 abstentions never consume — a swept permit settled late as low_confidence backs no scored row and cannot be relabelled into a rating (terminal guard), fresh abstention release spends no slot.
[B] Grant crypto/validator suite — `cd supabase/functions/api && npx --yes deno@2.5.6 test --no-prompt --frozen --lock=deno.lock __wf__/xc_offline_grant_crypto_adversary.test.ts` → exit 1; 7 executed / 5 passed / 2 failed / 0 skipped (crypto_run2.clean.log). FAILED = breaks OL-CR-1 (high-S malleability), OL-CR-7 (free grant exp unbounded). HELD: OL-CR-2 key rotation — kid/key mismatch, revoked kid, token-only kid all refused (invalid_key/invalid_signature), rotated grant verifies; OL-CR-3 clock rollback/skew — nowEpochSeconds before iat or ≥ exp is invalid_time, exp exclusive, exp-1 last valid second, fractional/unsafe/-0 times refused; OL-CR-4 Pro lease bounds — >7d, > verified entitlement expiry, entitlement expiry+1s, lifetime lease >7d all refuse to sign and verify; exact 7d and exp == entitlement expiry sign; OL-CR-5 receipts — time anchor issued before the grant, native elapsed time past exp, replayed lifecycleSequence, digest of the malleated envelope, owner switch all refused by validateOfflineResultReceiptBinding; OL-CR-6 reconciliation vs conflicting server state — pending+consumed, delivered result left reserved, partial result consumed, unused-ticket with result disposition, support_review consumed, unknown status/reason, owner/receipt-id mismatch all refused; only the contract's own pairs accepted.
[C] Mobile client suite — `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci __tests__/adv/offlineLeaseClient.adv.test.ts` → exit 0; 1 suite, 3 executed / 3 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (mobile_run2.clean.log). HELD: OL-MB-1 a server `access.paywall_required` on late sync (the client side of OL-PG-1) never deletes the executed rating, writes no receipt, spends exactly OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=8 attempts then leaves the drain, and deriveUploadQueueStatus reports needs_attention/exhausted=1 (visible, not silent); OL-MB-2 account switch while the sync answer is in flight raises DataOwnerChangedError, no receipt/delete lands in either owner bucket, B's drain touches only B, A's row is re-sent unchanged when A returns; OL-MB-3 40 consecutive transient failures (408/503/429/401/TypeError) never increment attempts, first real answer syncs with one receipt.
BASELINES (existing tests, unmodified): `cd supabase/functions/api && npx --yes deno@2.5.6 test --no-prompt --frozen --lock=deno.lock offlineSignature.test.ts canonicalDigest.test.ts` → exit 0, 227 passed / 0 failed (baseline_crypto.clean.log); `pnpm --filter @pickle/shared-types test` → exit 0, 22 files / 386 passed / 0 failed (baseline_shared_types.clean.log); existing `xc_pg_permit_lifecycle_adversary.test.ts` → exit 0, 10/10 passed (earlier in session). Lint/format on new files: root `npx prettier --check` + `npx eslint` on the Jest file → exit 0; `deno fmt`/`deno lint --config __wf__/deno.json` on both Deno files → clean; the crypto suite type-checks under the function deno.json; the PG suite follows the existing `--no-check` convention of __wf__ (same tx.unsafe jsonb pattern as the existing lifecycle adversary). `npx tsc --noEmit` in apps/mobile reports 0 errors in __tests__/adv (the only errors are pre-existing missing @sentry/* types in src/diagnostics/sentry.ts, unrelated).

ATTACKS TRIED: 18 (8 PG + 7 crypto/validator + 3 mobile), covering allocation vs consumption, disconnected reclaim, lease >7d / > entitlement / lifetime, clock rollback, signature + rotation failures, receipts/replay, delayed reconciliation with conflicting server state, malformed inputs, network loss/slow server, account switch, repeated/double actions, corrupted-time values. Existing HEAD tests already cover interrupted process death/relaunch of the run journal, malformed persisted outbox payloads, and missing-media/permission UI paths; those were not duplicated.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (needs Mac/device; no verdict claimed): native trusted-time anchor behaviour (OfflineNativeTimeEvidence monotonic clock across reboot/clock rollback), Keychain-vaulted wallet persistence across relaunch/reinstall, App Attest assertion generation, and StoreKit/RevenueCat entitlement lapse on a real device. At HEAD the mobile app has no offline wallet/grant execution path wired (offlineCapabilities: scoring dependency 'hybrid', degradation 'unavailable_offline'), so the grant crypto/validator attacks exercise the shared contract + edge signer only. Device commands a Mac run would need: `cd apps/mobile/ios && bundle exec pod install && cd .. && npx react-native run-ios --mode Debug` then toggle airplane mode between permit reservation and result sync for >24h / roll the device clock back, and `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` (coordinator-owned runner; NOT run here). Production Supabase untouched; no secrets printed.
